create_scale_by_adam: create an Adam optimizer gradient transformation with configurable decay rates and Nesterov momentum
create_scale_by_rms: create an RMSProp-style gradient transformation with exponential moving average of squared gradients
create_scale_by_adan: create an Adan optimizer gradient transformation with three decay rates for gradient, gradient difference, and squared term
create_scale_by_lbfgs: create a limited-memory BFGS gradient transformation that approximates the inverse Hessian from past parameter and gradient differences
create_scale_by_lion: create a Lion optimizer gradient transformation with hard, smooth, or refined sign-based update modes
